title: Response Simulation
description: VERIFY-stage advisory artifact. Output of review-response-simulator. Simulates anticipated reviewer/editor attacks on the work and records whether each is defensible. Advisory only (decision D) — does not block. An attack with defensible:false is an honest signal to the director that the submission may struggle at that point.

attacks.description: list of anticipated reviewer attacks; each records whether the team can defend against it

attack_class.description: category of attack (e.g. insufficient_power, unfair_baseline, dataset_leakage, overclaim, eval_frame_mismatch, out_of_scope, reproducibility)

attack_text.description: the specific reviewer attack, phrased as the reviewer would phrase it

defensible.description: true if the team has a solid rebuttal; false if this attack is currently indefensible (honest signal)

defense_argument.description: the rebuttal argument; may be empty when defensible is false

severity_if_indefensible.description: estimated impact on acceptance if this attack cannot be answered

indefensible_count.description: count of attacks with defensible:false; informational only

simulation_notes.description: optional notes on the simulation (e.g. which venue/conference was simulated)

run_ref.description: reference to the run this simulation covers
